_comment: Config for deploy/New-EdiscoveryHoldAndCollect.ps1. Author-only reference data - NOT applied to any tenant unless passed to the deploy script without -WhatIf. Drives the eDiscovery (Premium) case workflow via the Microsoft Graph eDiscovery API (v1.0 security namespace): create the case, add custodians and their mailbox/site sources, place a legal hold, and create a collection search. Export is a separate, opt-in step (-Export) against an existing review set - see README.md Sections 5 and 11.
description: Regulatory request - preserve and collect custodian communications for the 2026-014 matter.
_custodiansNote: Each custodian's primary SMTP address. includeSite=true also adds the custodian's OneDrive/SharePoint site source (includedSources 'site') in addition to their mailbox. Custodians must be real, licensed users in the tenant.

legalHold.name: 2026-014 Preservation Hold
legalHold.description: Preserve all custodian content for the duration of the 2026-014 matter.
legalHold._contentQueryNote: KQL. Empty = hold ALL content for the referenced sources (a preservation-in-place hold). Narrow ONLY with legal sign-off - an over-narrow hold risks spoliation. See design.md.

search.name: 2026-014 Collection
search.description: Collect custodian content responsive to the 2026-014 matter.
search._scopeNote: allCaseCustodians scopes the search to every custodian added to this case (simplest, grounded). Other values: none, allTenantMailboxes, allTenantSites, allCaseNoncustodialDataSources.

export.description: Export of the reviewed, responsive set for the 2026-014 matter.
export._exportNote: Export runs only with -Export and -ReviewSetId (a review set with content committed to it). exportOptions bitwise: originalFiles,text,pdfReplacement,tags(,splitSource,includeFolderAndPath,friendlyName,condensePaths). exportStructure: none|pst|msg ('directory' is deprecated). Committing search results into a review set (addToReviewSet) is a prerequisite - see README.md Section 11 VERIFY.
